finding.assessment: The later failed check provides evidence that the reported reviewer repair did not establish resolution, despite approval.

citations.excerpt: A later check still fails on empty input after merge. The earlier reviewer repair did not resolve the recurrence.
Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.

finding.contradictions: The reviewer reports a fix and regression test, but the later check reports continued failure. Merge is reported in the check narrative; landed_sha remains nil, so the exact tested and landed revisions cannot be verified.
finding.explanation: New audit evidence revises the existing finding: reviewer repair and approval were followed by a reported empty-input failure after merge.
finding.facts: The live-pg-a record retains an approve verdict and zero recovery attempts. Its cold_check now has passed=false and reports that empty input still fails after merge.
finding.hypothesis: The repair or regression test may have missed the failing path, or the checked revision may differ from the repaired revision. The supplied evidence does not distinguish these causes.
finding.improvement: Reproduce the later failure against an identified revision, check whether the reviewer-added regression exercises that case, and retain passing results tied to the final landed revision before declaring resolution.
finding.recurrence: This updates the existing cross-project finding with post-repair recurrence in live-pg-a. No new evidence is supplied for live-pg-b, and no additional independent occurrence is established.
finding.title: Empty-input failure persisted after reviewer repair and reported merge

revisions.assessment: Both approved runs report reviewer repair; independent verification and landing remain unestablished.

citations.excerpt: Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.
Reviewer again fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.

revisions.contradictions: Approval is consistent with repair before acceptance, but does not establish that the original implementation was complete. No test execution results or landed SHA are supplied.
revisions.explanation: The successful verdicts conceal a repeated validation omission that reviewers report correcting before approval.
revisions.facts: In live-pg-a for insights-pg and live-pg-b for insights-other, review reports state that reviewers fixed missing empty-input validation and added a regression test. Both records have an approve verdict and zero recovery attempts.
revisions.hypothesis: Implementation-stage edge-case checks may be insufficient, leaving reviewers to supply validation and regression coverage.
revisions.improvement: Include empty-input behavior and regression coverage during implementation, and retain test execution evidence alongside reviewer repair and approval.
revisions.recurrence: The same reported omission appears in two runs across different projects. Both share task-73 and batch-test, so independent causes are not established. No previous finding was supplied.
revisions.title: Approved runs repeatedly required reviewer fixes for empty-input validation
